description: Figure 7(b) displays a donut chart titled “Task Type,” illustrating the distribution of task types for Agency A. The chart is segmented into three colored portions: a large red segment representing “Article generation” at 83.2%, a yellow segment for “Headline generation” at 16.8%, and a small blue segment for “Article editing” at 0%. The chart visually emphasizes that article generation dominates the task distribution for this agency, with headline generation being the only other significant category, while article editing is not present in the data for Agency A.
